patch_description: Combines the best-performing ideas from prior programs (full-lookahead greedy multistart with tie-breaking randomness, depth-adaptive beam search, SA with insertion intensification) and adds a novel Large Neighborhood Search (LNS) phase: repeatedly remove a random contiguous block of k transactions from the best schedule and greedily re-insert them at optimal positions, evaluated by true makespan. This "ruin-and-recreate" paradigm explores a different neighborhood than insertion/swap moves and escapes local optima that block pure local search. Also raises the time budget to 28s and dedupes candidates for seed diversity.
